original_test_intent: Verify that ESC leaves the identified BIOS Setup page and returns to the expected parent context without saving, discarding or changing configuration.
original_method: Start from the approved page with no pending changes, capture the current and expected parent contexts, press ESC once, verify the exact return destination and absence of prompts or configuration effects, then exit safely.
manual_activity: A human operator must establish the correct page and no-pending-change state, press ESC once, visually verify the expected parent context and avoid any unexpected save/discard prompt.
required_inputs: Exact host/console and BIOS page identity
Validated physical or remote pre-OS input/capture
Safe return/no-save path and any separate Setup-entry approval
safety_requirements: Press ESC only on the approved page
Do not use this case to discard a change
Take no action on an unexpected prompt
Stop on wrong context or unreadable output
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Verify supplied page/parent reference and no-pending-change declaration
Report without performing the key action or deciding the verdict
engineer_actions: Approve context and any Setup entry
Press ESC and visually review return context
Exit safely and own final verdict

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain one operator-driven ESC action on the pinned page with no pending changes, and compare the returned page to the approved parent reference.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: ESC, exit a page and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record page identity, focus, one ESC action, returned parent page and absence of prompts or configuration diff in one timestamped capture.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a deterministic navigation oracle and no-discard boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; page exit behavior remains the only test target.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: ESC behavior varies by page and firmware and may expose a discard/save prompt if a change is pending.

project_override_considerations: A deliberate discard workflow must be a separately approved case with known values; it cannot be inferred from this normal navigation check.
expected_evidence: Expected parent reference and no-pending-change declaration
No save/discard prompt or configuration change
Safe no-save exit and preserved logs
